question.value: Does a large amount of diffuse molecular gas in the bar of NGC 1300 (not contributing to star formation) make the star formation efficiency appear low there?

evidence.quote: we investigate the possibility that the presence of a large amount of diffuse molecular gas, which would not contribute to the SF, makes the SFE low in appearance.

claims.hypothesis: Diffuse molecular gas makes bar SFE appear low
claims.experiment: Compared f_dif (1 - ALMA/NRO flux) with SFE per environment
claims.result: Bar f_dif 0.74-0.91 with SFE 0.06-0.16 Gyr^-1; arm/bar-end f_dif 0.28-0.65, SFE 0.23-0.96
claims.finding: SFE decreases with f_dif, supporting diffuse gas as a cause

evidence.quote: This result supports the idea that the presence of a large amount of diffuse molecular gas makes the SFE low.

claims.hypothesis: Diffuse gas alone explains the low bar SFE
claims.result: SFE_GMC still lower in bar (0.17 and <0.04 vs ~1.6 in arms)
claims.finding: Other mechanisms such as fast CCCs also needed

evidence.quote: The suppression of the SFE in the bar has also been seen even when we exclude the diffuse molecular gas components.

why_this_data.value: ALMA 12-m lacking ACA is insensitive to extended gas, so combined with NRO total flux it measures diffuse fraction

evidence.quote: which has no sensitivity on extended molecular gases due to lack of Atacama Compact Array (ACA; 7-m + TP) data

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Unbound clouds (virial parameter) scenario disfavoured by Maeda 2020 and Fujimoto 2020

evidence.quote: these results suggest that the SF suppression in the bar can not be explained by a systematic difference of virial parameter.

limitations_admitted.value: alpha_CO may be a factor of a few lower in the bar, so Sigma_mol could be overestimated

evidence.quote: there is a possibility that the $\Sigma_{\rm mol}$ in the bar regions of NGC 1300 may be overestimated by a factor of a few

limitations_admitted.value: SFR below 1e-3 Msun/yr/kpc2 should be considered upper limits

evidence.quote: should be considered to be an upper limit
